messages:
maya: quick sync 52 we need to lock streaming semantics for chat/completions for the upcoming milestone. need clear launch criteria so eng can scope.

devon: +1. two big questions: transport (SSE vs WS) and a single delta envelope that works for both. runtime wants text-first small deltas to keep KV cache predictable.

irene: customer inputs: fintech partner requires resume + auditable ops (on-prem), mobile wants tiny frames and graceful finish signals, and one platform customer requested early function-call partials so they can kick off external work.

samir: from evals: partial token order + consistent finish reasons are non-negotiable. propose canonical finish_reasons: "stop", "length", "user_interrupt", "error", "function_call_complete", "function_call_aborted".

raj: SDK note: WS adds complexity for mobile web (service workers + reconnect logic). SSE is simpler and plays nicer with proxies but doesn't support client->server control frames.

maya: suggestion: define a transport-agnostic envelope that maps cleanly to SSE lines and WS messages. core contract suggestion: each event is an object encoded as a single-line JSON string in the stream with fields: op ("delta"|"event"|"meta"), seq (int optional), payload (string or object), finish_reason (optional). finalization must be explicit.

devon: implementation detail: networks sometimes drop the final frame. we should require a final "meta" event like {"op":"meta","final":true,"finish_reason":"..."} so clients know the stream completed.

samir: add resumability: when server allows resume, meta should include a short-lived resume_token and last_seq: {"op":"meta","resume_token":"<token>","last_seq":123,"final":false}. tokens must be HMAC-scoped and expiring.

leo: security: resume tokens HMAC(session_id|model|last_seq|expiry) and flagged in audit logs. do not encode user PII in tokens. enterprise on-prem can configure token TTL.

tanner: bank asked for backpressure signals for web proxies. propose a lightweight pressure event: {"op":"meta","pressure":"high"}. clients can react (reduce fidelity / switch to polling) or show UX.

maya: agree. spec should recommend client fallback ladder: 1) continue streaming (best-effort), 2) request compact deltas (tokens-only) via header/param, 3) fall back to polling/poll+status. provide SDK helpers for this.

raj: rough plan: implement SSE-compatible streaming + envelope + final meta in server + SDK wrappers for JS/iOS/Android = 3w eng + 1w SDK + 1w canary. WS opt-in in next cycle.

devon: tradeoffs: frame size vs frequency. mobile likes smaller frames but that increases overhead and potential TCP push. add server-side configs: min_tokens_per_frame (default 1), max_frame_bytes (default 12k).

samir: delta schema suggestion (text-first + optional structured): examples in stream (each line is a JSON event):

```
{"op":"delta","seq":1,"payload":"Hel"}
{"op":"delta","seq":2,"payload":"lo ","annotations":{"token_index":4}}
{"op":"delta","seq":3,"payload":"World","finish_reason":"stop"}
```

for function partials: include function_call partial as payload object: 

```
{"op":"delta","seq":10,"payload":{"type":"function_call","name":"get_user","args":"{\"id\":\"u-123\"}","partial":true}}
{"op":"meta","seq":11,"resume_token":"<sig>","final":false}
```

maya: SDKs should expose helpers: StreamClient.resume(resume_token), StreamClient.onPressure(cb), StreamClient.onDelta(fn), and an option to prefer_compact_deltas=true.

ops-bot: deploy-note: feature flag "streaming/transport/envelope_v1" created. toggle=false by default.

devon: launch criteria proposal:
- server supports envelope_v1 over SSE (canary on dedicated infra)
- JS/iOS/Android SDKs provide resume & final-event handling, and compact delta opt-in
- finish_reason canonicalization validated by evals (no regressions on 10 eval sets)
- security review for resume token scheme completed
- canary serving >100k streaming tokens/day with <0.1% missing-final events

irene: product acceptance: include docs with example server->client logs, failure cases (dropped final frame, stale resume token, partial function args), and migration guide for older clients.

maya: OK, next steps: devon/raj to finalize envelope shape and header/param names this week, samir to produce finish_reason canonical list and eval plan, leo to draft resume token spec for security review, tanner to collate customer proxy/backpressure needs. we'll reconvene Friday. :thumbsup:
